name: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides general insurance and reinsurance products in Qatar. The company offers personal insurance, including motor, mandatory visitors', medical, travel, home, yacht, housemaid, and personal accident insurance; corporate insurance, such as property, marine, engineering, energy, corporate motor, liability and miscellaneous, and group medical insurance; and specialty lines comprising cyber, medical malpractice, directors and officers, errors and omissions, professional indemnity, fine art and valuables, and event cancellation insurance.
